codes.BIL_REASON_REQUIRED: Give a reason: a collected line is corrected or left out only with one.
codes.BIL_LINE_EXCLUDED: The line is left out of the basis. Include it again first.
codes.BIL_NOT_COLLECTED: A line added by hand has no source to go back to.
codes.BIL_NOTHING_TO_REVERT: The line already follows its source.
codes.BIL_NO_CONFLICT: The line has no conflict to resolve.
codes.BIL_UNRESOLVED_CONFLICTS: Some lines changed at their source after Finance decided about them. Resolve them before approving.
codes.BIL_BASIS_LOCKED: The basis is approved and can no longer be changed; corrections belong in the next period.
codes.BIL_SAME_APPROVER: One person cannot give both approvals of a run. The other approval has to come from someone else.
codes.BIL_ALREADY_APPROVED: This approval has already been given for the current revision.
codes.BIL_NO_SECOND_APPROVAL: No customer is above the threshold, so the run needs no management approval.
codes.BIL_APPROVER_REQUIRED: Only a signed-in CRM user can approve.
codes.BIL_APPROVER_INACTIVE: Your CRM account is not active, so you cannot approve.
codes.BIL_INVALID_STATUS: The run is no longer in a state that allows this. Reload the page to see where it stands.
codes.BIL_PERIOD_ALREADY_BILLED: This month is already billed and closed. Create a supplementary run: it bills only what was not billed yet.
codes.BIL_NOTHING_TO_SUPPLEMENT: This month has no closed run yet; bill it with a regular run first.
codes.BIL_COLLECT_BUSY: Another run is being collected right now. Try again in a moment.
codes.BIL_RECONCILE_FIRST: An order may already exist in PowerOffice. Check it and reconcile the basis before cancelling it.
codes.BIL_NOT_EXPORTED: Only an exported basis is corrected with a new line; change an open basis directly.
codes.BIL_CREDIT_NOT_ENABLED: A negative correction is a credit note and is made in PowerOffice.
codes.BIL_INVALID_BASIS_STATUS: The basis is no longer in a state that allows this. Reload the page to see where it stands.
codes.BIL_ORDER_NO_REQUIRED: Give the number of the order found in PowerOffice.
codes.BIL_CHARGE_INVALID_STATUS: The charge has changed meanwhile. Reload the page and try again.
codes.OUTBOX_REPLAY_STALE: The list changed meanwhile: some messages were replayed or delivered already. Check the list and confirm again.
codes.OUTBOX_REPLAY_LIMIT: At most 100 messages can be replayed at a time.
codes.OUTBOX_REPLAY_REASON: Say why the messages are replayed (at least 10 characters).
codes.OUTBOX_UNKNOWN_MODULE: The message belongs to a module that does not exist.
codes.INT_OUTBOUND_RUNNING: The change is being sent right now; try again in a moment.
codes.SAL_DOCUMENT_PREPARING: The document is being stored; it can be downloaded or sent in a moment.
codes.SAL_DOCUMENT_UNAVAILABLE: The stored document cannot be read, so nothing was sent. Contact the administrator.
codes.SAL_DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND: This document revision does not exist.
codes.SAL_QUOTE_OWNER_NOT_ALLOWED: You can only make yourself the owner. To pass the quote on, hand it over.
codes.SAL_QUOTE_NOT_CURRENT: Only the current version can be handed over; the earlier ones follow it.
codes.SAL_QUOTE_OWNER_UNKNOWN: That person is not an active CRM user.
codes.PRJ_MEMBER_UNKNOWN: That person is not an active CRM user.
codes.TIM_PROJECT_NOT_AVAILABLE: The project does not exist or you are not on it.
codes.TIM_PROJECT_OTHER_ORGANIZATION: The project belongs to another customer than the time entry.
codes.TIM_PROJECT_CLOSED: The project is completed or cancelled and takes no more hours.
codes.AUTH_REVERIFY_REQUIRED: This action needs your permissions confirmed by Microsoft in the last few minutes. Sign out, sign in again and repeat it.
codes.PRV_CASE_NOT_PREVIEWED: Preview the erasure plan before carrying it out.
codes.PRV_CASE_NOT_VERIFIED: The requester's identity has not been verified yet.
codes.PRV_CASE_WRONG_KIND: This step does not belong to this kind of request.
codes.PRV_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: Type the request number to confirm the erasure.
codes.PRV_EXECUTION_INCOMPLETE: Not every module could finish; what was done stays done. Carry the erasure out again to continue.
codes.PRV_HOLD_IN_PAST: A legal hold must end today or later.
codes.PRV_HOLD_NOT_FOUND: This legal hold does not exist.
codes.PRV_HOLD_RELEASED: The legal hold was already released.
codes.PRV_PLAN_CHANGED: The person's data changed since the plan was previewed. Preview the plan again and check it.
codes.PRV_SUBJECT_NOT_FOUND: The person this request is about does not exist.
codes.PRV_SUPPRESSED: This person was erased at their request and is not imported again without a new lawful basis.
codes.SAL_DOCUMENT_ERASED: This quote document was erased at the request of the person on it; it is no longer shown or sent.
codes.PRIVACY_REPLAY_PENDING: The database was restored from a backup and erasures made after it are being applied again. Try again in a minute.
codes.MAINTENANCE_READ_ONLY: The CRM is read-only for maintenance. Nothing was saved; try again when the maintenance ends.
codes.MAINTENANCE_STATE_UNAVAILABLE: Nothing was sent: whether the CRM is in maintenance cannot be read right now. Try again in a minute.
codes.MAINTENANCE_CHANGED: Another maintenance decision was taken meanwhile. Look at the current state before changing it.
codes.MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED: Switch the CRM to read-only maintenance before reconciling a restore.
codes.REPORT_NOT_FOUND: The reconciliation report was not found.
codes.MONITORING_RETRY_STALE: The selection changed. Reload the list and confirm the current operations.
codes.MONITORING_RETRY_INVALID: Confirm 1–100 operations and give a reason of 10–500 characters.
codes.MONITORING_NOT_FOUND: The exception is no longer available or is no longer accessible. Refresh the list.
codes.MONITORING_TRIAGE_INVALID: Choose a valid status and keep the comment within 2,000 characters.
codes.MONITORING_TRIAGE_STALE: Another operator changed this review. Close it and reload before saving again.
codes.MONITORING_STILL_ACTIVE: The source still reports this exception. Verify recovery and refresh before resolving it.
codes.OUTBOX_REPLAY_PARTIAL: Replay stopped after a partial failure. Check each result. Verify unknown outcomes before creating a new selection.

delivery.title: Event delivery
delivery.description: Events one module could not deliver to another: after ten failed attempts (dead letter) or because the stored message cannot be read (quarantine). Fix the cause first, then replay: the stored message is delivered unchanged, and handlers that already finished are skipped.
delivery.counts: {{module}}: {{deadLetter}} dead letters, {{quarantined}} quarantined, {{pending}} waiting for delivery
delivery.newestShown: The newest {{shown}} of {{total}} undelivered events are listed; once they are replayed, the next ones appear.
delivery.empty: Nothing waits for a person: no dead letters and no quarantined events.
delivery.limit: At most {{max}} messages per replay: the first {{max}} are taken.
delivery.requestedNotice_one: Replay of {{count}} message requested; crm-worker delivers it within seconds.
delivery.requestedNotice_other: Replay of {{count}} messages requested; crm-worker delivers them within seconds.
delivery.confirmBody: Each message is delivered as it was stored. Handlers that already finished are skipped; the others run once. Who asked and why is recorded in the audit log.
delivery.reasonHint: What was fixed — at least {{min}} characters. Recorded in the audit log.

linkedSystems.title: Linked systems

detail.inUse: The product is used in a price list, bundle or contract, so it cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead: it stays in existing contracts but cannot be added to new ones.
detail.notLinked: Not linked to a PowerOffice product yet. Products billed through PowerOffice need a link, otherwise the billing run flags them.

priceLists.explainer: For each customer category only one active price list may apply on a given day. Individual contract prices take precedence.

priceLists.itemsExplainer: Products without a price here use their list price.
priceLists.noItems: No prices in this list yet.
priceLists.overlap: The period overlaps the active price list “{{name}}” for the same category.

categories.explainer: The category of a contract selects its price list; the markup applies to Microsoft licence prices.
categories.codeHint: Short code, cannot be changed later.

priceSheet.previewResult: {{matched}} products matched, {{changed}} prices change, {{withoutProduct}} offers without a product. Markup {{markup}} %.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.waiting: Revision {{revision}} of the run is waiting for approval.
approvals.released: Revision {{revision}} was approved and released for sending.
approvals.releasedLegacy: Approved before approvals were tied to a revision of the run.
approvals.needsOne: One approval by Finance is needed.
approvals.needsTwo: A customer is above the threshold: Finance and management have to approve, two different people, in either order.
approvals.resetBanner: Earlier approvals no longer count; revision {{revision}} has to be approved again.
approvals.otherPerson: You have approved this revision. The other approval has to come from someone else.

reasons.Recollected: The run was collected again afterwards.
reasons.BasisCancelled: A customer basis was cancelled afterwards.
reasons.ContentChanged: The content no longer matched what was approved.
reasons.Migrated: Given before approvals were tied to a revision of the run.

supplementary.label: Supplementary run
supplementary.hint: For a month that is already billed and closed: the run bills only what no earlier run billed, such as hours approved late.

reconcile.banner: A send to PowerOffice got no answer and no order with this basis as its reference was found. Check PowerOffice and record what is there; the basis is not sent again until then.
reconcile.sending: The order is being sent to PowerOffice. If the send gets no answer, the basis waits for reconciliation instead of being sent twice.
reconcile.title: Reconcile with PowerOffice
reconcile.body: Look the order up in PowerOffice by the customer and the period.
reconcile.manualTitle: Record an order made outside the CRM
reconcile.manualBody: Use this when the basis was invoiced by hand in PowerOffice, for example during an incident. The order number is recorded as if the CRM had sent it, so no later run bills these lines again.

correction.title: Add a correction
correction.body: The order already in PowerOffice stays as it is. The amount is billed by the next run as a new line that refers to “{{description}}”. A credit is made in PowerOffice.
correction.queued: The correction is queued for the next run

legacy.title: Lines billed before the charge register
legacy.summary_one: {{count}} line from before the charge register cannot be matched to its source. Until you decide, the days it may cover are not billed again.
legacy.summary_other: {{count}} lines from before the charge register cannot be matched to their source. Until you decide, the days they may cover are not billed again.
legacy.summaryAmount_one: {{count}} line ({{amount}}) from before the charge register cannot be matched to its source. Until you decide, the days it may cover are not billed again.
legacy.summaryAmount_other: {{count}} lines ({{amount}}) from before the charge register cannot be matched to their source. Until you decide, the days they may cover are not billed again.
legacy.billedBody: The customer received this line back then; it keeps the days it covers from being billed again.
legacy.notBilledBody: The line never reached the customer; a supplementary run may bill the days again.

billing.secondApprovalNeeded: A customer is above {{amount}}, so management has to approve as well.
billing.failedBases: {{count}} customers could not be sent; open the customer to see why.
billing.closeBody: A closed run cannot be collected or sent again. The bases are kept as the basis for the invoices.
billing.noBases: Nothing to bill in this period.

conflict.SourceChanged: The source changed after Finance decided about this line.
conflict.SourceChangedAmount: The source changed after the correction and now says {{amount}}.
conflict.LegacyUnmatched: Corrected before charge keys existed, so it cannot be matched to its source safely.

billing.reasonHint: A collected line is corrected only with a reason; it is kept with the line and in the history.
billing.excludeTitle: Leave the line out of the basis?
billing.excludeBody: The line stays visible but is not invoiced, and the next collect does not bring it back. It can be included again.
billing.usedSource: The line follows its source again
billing.keepBody: Say why the decision still holds against what the source says now.
billing.conflictsBanner_one: {{count}} line needs a decision: its source changed after Finance decided about it. The run cannot be approved until it is resolved.
billing.conflictsBanner_other: {{count}} lines need a decision: their source changed after Finance decided about them. The run cannot be approved until they are resolved.

anomalyTexts.BIL_STALE_QUANTITY: {{product}}: the quantity comes from a reading of {{date}}, which is older than the limit.
anomalyTexts.BIL_NO_DEVICE_SNAPSHOT: {{product}} is billed per device, but no daily device count exists; the devices listed now are counted.
anomalyTexts.BIL_INCOMPLETE_HOURS: The latest import of work hours ({{date}}) did not finish completely; hours may be missing from this basis.

billing.productHint: The product decides the VAT rate and the product code sent to PowerOffice.
billing.retried: The customer is back in the queue

maintenance.title: Maintenance and restore
maintenance.subtitle: Read-only mode for a database restore or an incident, and the reconciliation before sending resumes (runbook 03).

banner.title: Read-only maintenance
banner.body: The CRM is read-only for maintenance. You can read everything; changes are not saved until it ends.
banner.bodySince: The CRM has been read-only for maintenance since {{since}}. You can read everything; changes are not saved until it ends.

signIn.title: Signing in is paused
signIn.body: The CRM is in maintenance, and signing in waits until it ends.
signIn.bodySince: The CRM has been in maintenance since {{since}}, and signing in waits until it ends.

state.title: Current state
state.forced: This deployment is read-only by configuration (Maintenance:ForceReadOnly). Only a new revision without it ends the maintenance.

inFlight.title: Under way
inFlight.hint: Before the restore point is taken, every count must be 0 and stay 0 for a few more seconds (runbook 03).

switch.title: Switch
switch.reasonHint: {{min}}–{{max}} characters; everyone signed in sees it in the banner.
switch.referenceHint: Change or incident number, if there is one.
switch.confirmReadOnlyBody: Every change is refused for everyone, the worker stops sending, and signing in waits until normal operation returns.
switch.confirmNormalBody: Changes are accepted again and the worker resumes sending. After a restore, apply the reconciliation first.

reconcile.title: Restore reconciliation
reconcile.intro: After a restore, compares what left the CRM after the restore point with the restored copy, before sending resumes.
reconcile.needsReadOnly: Switch to read-only first: reconciling while the worker sends would race with it.
reconcile.restorePointHint: The moment the database was restored to, in UTC.
reconcile.invalidPoint: Give a restore point in the past.
reconcile.applyHint: Apply is available after a dry run for the same restore point.
reconcile.confirmBody: What the journal shows sent after the restore point is held for a person: bases wait for Finance, outbound operations are held, posts and e-mails that left are marked as sent.

report.title: Report of {{at}}
report.effects: Journal entries after the restore point
report.subject: Subject

monitoring.title: Monitoring and exception review
monitoring.description: Freshness is based on the last successful sync. Failed or skipped attempts do not refresh stored data.
monitoring.viewsHint: Up to 10 views saved for your account in this browser. Saving the same name replaces its filters.
monitoring.storageFailed: The view could not be saved in this browser. Check browser storage settings.
monitoring.commentHint: Record the investigation and recovery check (up to 2,000 characters). Do not include credentials, customer details or amounts.

impacts.SyncFailed: The latest update failed; stored records may lag behind the source.
impacts.SyncStale: Source data exceeded the configured freshness limit.
impacts.OutboundFailed: Queued changes have not reached the external system.
impacts.Unmapped: Source records cannot be connected to CRM records.
impacts.Paused: Updates are held by an operator decision.
impacts.OutboxDeadLetter: Dependent business changes are waiting for delivery.
impacts.OutboxQuarantined: A handler rejected an event; dependent work is on hold.
impacts.ReviewOverdueCharges: Charges remain unbilled beyond the review window.
impacts.VerifyExternalEffect: Confirm the external outcome before any retry to avoid duplicate billing.
impacts.ReviewLegacyCharges: Legacy charge identities need a financial review.
impacts.ResolveBillingConflicts: Billing cannot proceed until conflicting source changes are reviewed.
impacts.ReviewEstimatedQuantities: Open billing bases rest on old readings or an incomplete hours import; Finance decides whether they may be billed.
impacts.MapSubscriptions: Subscriptions are not connected to a CRM customer or product.
impacts.ReviewPreviousMonthLicenseMargin: Previous-month licence cost and revenue need reconciliation.
impacts.QuoteDocumentsUnavailable: Quote documents are not ready for download or sending.
impacts.Other: Review the source and verify recovery before closing the exception.
impacts.ReconfirmDirectoryRoles: Role changes cannot be confirmed; privileged actions may be refused.

recovery.Other: Assign an owner, inspect the source, apply the documented recovery and confirm a successful new observation. Keep the comment free of sensitive details.
recovery.SyncFailed: Inspect the failed job and configuration. After correcting the cause, run it again and verify that the last successful time advances.
recovery.SyncStale: Check the worker, schedule and provider. Verify a successful sync within the freshness limit; a skipped or failed attempt is not recovery.
recovery.Paused: Confirm the pause is intentional with its owner. Resume from the system card only when ready, then verify a successful sync and queue recovery.
recovery.OutboundFailed: Check the external outcome first. Select concrete failed operations below and retry with a reason only when a duplicate external effect is ruled out.
recovery.OutboxDeadLetter: Correct the handler failure. Select the exact events in Event delivery below, give a reason and verify each replay result and subsequent worker delivery.
recovery.OutboxQuarantined: Review why the event was quarantined before replaying it. Correct the handler or configuration and verify each requested event is delivered.

monitoring.retryHint: Only the listed operations will be retried. Check their outcome in the external system first.
monitoring.resolveAfterRecovery: Resolve this review after the source has recovered.
monitoring.recoveredLimit: The list includes the {{shown}} most recently reviewed recovered exceptions out of {{total}} awaiting closure. Filters apply to this list; close completed reviews to see older cases.
